description:
Make the model->HTML transform in the Python docs generator a pure, deep module by feeding its assets (template + css) through its interface instead of reading them from disk itself.

Source: architecture review (2026-07-17), candidate 4 ('worth exploring', ports & adapters). Independent of the candidate-3 scanner epic (tb-dkx) — different module.

Today render_html(packages, toolchains) reads assets/style.css and assets/index.html.tmpl via Path(__file__).parent, so the transform cannot be exercised without those files on disk and its tests assert on substrings of hand-built HTML while silently depending on the real assets. Injecting template + css concentrates file I/O at the __main__ edge and makes the transform pure. A follow-up closes the adjacent no-escaping gap in row rendering.
title: Deepen docs renderer: assets through the interface
